summary: Iteration 8 — Tested new user preferences API, AI suggest-tasks, single-model fast-path, favorite-bias auto-best, AIComposer refactor, SuggestTasksDialog, and white-calendar-icon CSS. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_new_features.py with 12 new tests covering all 5 new requirements + 3 regression. All 12 pass. Full regression: 94/95 pass (only failure is pre-existing flaky CoinGecko 429 from iter7). FRONTEND E2E (Amit demo): AIComposer submit label is dynamic ('ASK CLAUDE'/'ASK 2 MODELS · COMPARE'/'ASK GEMINI'); DEFAULT AI Select PATCHes /api/user/preferences and updates label (saw Default AI · Gemini toast); SuggestTasksDialog opens on Convert-to-task (yellow button next to user message), shows N AI-suggested task rows each with checkbox/title/desc/assignee-select/priority-select/date-input, '+ Add another task' adds blank row, 'CREATE 3 TASKS & NOTIFY' creates and closes dialog. Old NewTaskDialog NOT used (count=0). Calendar-picker-indicator CSS rule with 'brightness(0) invert(1)' is present and applied to date inputs in dialog (visually verified white icons in screenshot). FIXED 1 backend crash: GET /api/ai/models was 500 due to missing 'real' key in MODEL_CONFIG.

minor.issue: Was returning 500 (KeyError: 'real') because MODEL_CONFIG entries don't have 'real' key. FIXED by deriving from engine type in server.py list_models().

ui_bugs.issue: AIComposer opens with 3 models pre-selected (chatgpt, claude, gemini) instead of favorite-only single-tool mode. Spec says 'by default only that one model is selected (single-tool fast path, no synthesis)'. Root cause: Chats.jsx line 407 passes defaultModels={chat.default_models || ['chatgpt','claude','gemini']} which AIComposer honors (length>=2 branch at line 43). Fix: pass defaultModels={chat.default_models || undefined} so AIComposer falls back to favorite-only.

action_items: Chats.jsx: change defaultModels prop to defaultModels={chat.default_models || undefined} so AIComposer single-tool fast-path is the default (currently overridden by 3-model array — contradicts spec).
Optionally enrich MODEL_CONFIG with explicit 'real' booleans rather than relying on engine type.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_models had a KeyError on 'real' (fixed in this iteration) — indicates schema drift between MODEL_CONFIG (no 'real' key) and the endpoint contract. Add a unit test or a Pydantic response model to lock the shape.

AIComposer's two sources of default selection (parent-passed defaultModels vs user preferences fetch) race. Currently if parent passes ≥2 it wins, hiding the new single-tool fast-path. Either remove the parent override or have AIComposer always start at favorite-only and only honor parent override if explicit (e.g. force=true prop).

MessageBubble.jsx now correctly uses data-testid='aitask-${msg.id}' for AI synthesized 'Create task & assign' and 'task-${msg.id}' for user-message 'Convert to task' — addresses the iter7 testid-duplication note.

_finalize_research single-model fast path is good but if the lone response is from a failed model (real=False fallback answer), it skips synthesis silently. Acceptable but worth a metadata.degraded flag for clients.
server.py still ~1463 lines; routing module split is still pending from iter 4-6.
Pre-existing: test_inline_task_command.py crashes at import without REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set (carried since iter 6 — should read URL via conftest fixture).

The remaining UI bug is in Chats.jsx where AIComposer is given a hardcoded 3-model defaultModels prop that shadows the new single-tool fast-path; verify after main agent fix that opening AIComposer for a chat without chat.default_models shows label 'Ask <Favorite>' and a single yellow-active toggle. SuggestTasksDialog flow is fully working — verified via screenshot that calendar icons render light/white on the date inputs.
rca of the issue: 1) /api/ai/models 500: MODEL_CONFIG schema was missing 'real' key; list_models() blindly indexed v['real']. Fixed by computing real = v.get('real', v.get('engine') in ('emergent','openai_compat')). 2) AIComposer always starting at 3-models: Chats.jsx line 407 supplies defaultModels=['chatgpt','claude','gemini'] when chat.default_models is falsy, and AIComposer respects any defaultModels array of length≥2 (line 43). The new 'single-tool fast-path = favorite-only by default' from this iteration is therefore unreachable unless the chat explicitly stores a single default_model. Fix is one-line in Chats.jsx (drop the fallback array).
